title: Stream Table: Where Sediment Settles

serves.summary: The learner sets the water speed on a stream table so pebbles, sand and silt settle at marked places and build layers, which shows that water drops its largest grains first where it slows down.

request.topic: Erosion and deposition: where moving water drops its sediment
request.objective: Explain that water or wind drops its sediment where it slows down, the largest grains first, and that this builds layers.

problems.ask: Make the sand come to rest at the sand flag.
problems.goal: After the last run the sand rests in stretch 3: the water is fast enough to carry sand through stretches 1 and 2 and slows below sand's carrying speed in stretch 3.
